specs.name: 原款短须
specs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / stylized-concept.
Asset: ONE finished male portrait for the existing modular Chinese cultivation game, same 1024x1536 whole-canvas upright portrait as reference image1.
STYLE AUTHORITY: Image1 is the approved CURRENT PROJECT MASTER, its painting hand, warm pale peach skin, low contrast, delicate gongbi ink-and-wash shading, charcoal-brown black fine individual hair strokes and matte finish are binding. All characters are East Asian adult men. Preserve the master paper-beige backdrop, same green-and-muted-gold flower/cloud robe, shoulder width, torso, neckline, belt, crop, lighting direction and painted surface. Change only the requested head/face/hair/beard design. Do not redesign clothing.
Shared head placement guides in this full canvas: centered face near x516, pupils around x460/568,y366, nose tip around x516,y442, lip center around x517,y478, chin around x518,y541. Preserve overall eye and neck/collar registration as closely as native image generation allows; do not enlarge eyes/head. These are composition guides, not a claim of modular registration.
CRITICAL PALETTE: match the skin of image1 directly (light warm peach; forehead about RGB231,204,188; cheeks about235,205,188). The face must not get tanned, ocher, orange, gray, or overwhite as features become stronger. Keep gray-black hair shade and fine subdued highlights exactly in the master family. No gray/white aging hair.
Aesthetic: believable ordinary male game portrait, restrained and characterful; attractive enough to be comfortable to look at but not a flawless fashion model, romantic idol, androgynous flower-boy or sharply sculpted celebrity. Use natural proportions, modest-sized horizontally oriented eyes, small natural irises, individually drawn brows and subtle lips, no make-up, no eyeliner wings, no glossy lips, no thick eyelashes, no movie-poster contrast, no photo skin pores, no gritty hyperrealism, no cartoon/anime. Both eyes are a coherent pair with matching opening/iris scales and level pupils; preserve only very slight natural hand-painted differences.
Do not add middle-age forehead wrinkles, crow's feet or aging folds; this request has explicitly PAUSED middle-aged design. Healthy adult face, smooth softly painted skin. No scars, grotesque exaggeration, extreme hollow cheeks or deep nasolabial lines. No text, labels, collage, border or comparison board. One complete character only.
Image1 is the EDIT TARGET: preserve his EXISTING YOUNG ADULT FACE IDENTITY, eyes, eyebrows, nose, lips, hair silhouette and all outside the facial hair. Image2 is only a FACIAL-HAIR SHAPE REFERENCE: copy its softly drawn short moustache over the upper lip and closely trimmed short chin/jaw beard. DO NOT copy image2's middle-aged face, broader nose, older eye wrinkles, wider jaw or tan skin.
Add that same discreet SHORT charcoal-black moustache and short close-cropped goatee/jaw beard to image1 at the current mouth/chin anchors. Individual sparse tapered hairs, soft brown-black roots and slightly denser chin, modest natural moustache parted at philtrum, lips fully readable. No long hanging beard, no thick solid dark mask, no cheek covering, no gray hair, no change to age. The beard should match the existing scalp hair texture and ink values and sit naturally on the same pale skin. This is the key requested short-beard trial on the existing project man.
